Event Now! shows Victoria, Australia events using a handy timemap, it also integrates with Google Calendar to let you save your events, invite friends and set sms reminders. Entrant in the App My State government mashup contest.
Great for runners, hikers, bicyclist and anyone else interested in how far they ran, walked, biked, or traveled. Map, save, find, and share your routes.

Architecture 2030 study of climate induced sea level rise on coastal cities in United States. See side by side images of what will happen.

MYOB AccountRight Live is an accounting application for businesses in Australia. MYOB AccountRight Live offers a variety of accounting and bookkeeping features.The MYOB AccountRight Live API allows developers to access and integrate the functionality and data of MYOB AccountRight Live with other applications. Some example API methods include managing accounting files, retrieving information on accounts, and managing transactions.
